description: core/settings/Settings.js: pages, sections, module info files, list edits (tests/settings.test.mjs). `effectiveValue` and `shownFields` take a `values` object for `valueOf`; `sortWorkspaces` returns a sorted copy.

cases.name: a host page replaces keys of a core page
the last matching core page wins
two host pages with the same new id merge
a page without an id matches one without
no id
cases.knownDiff: JS compares "" with undefined (!==) and says true; Rust reads a missing id as "" and says false

cases.name: the general page is the default
a missing sub-page falls to its parent
from a sub-page it moves from its parent
an unknown page starts at the end
null in the config is a value
a field shows while its condition holds
a value not in the list hides it
a condition on an unset key without default
an empty when is no condition
the general page takes fields without one
settings that is not a list

settings.label: Folder
settings.help: Where Claude starts; ~ is your home. Empty is notchd's own folder, notchd in your Documents folder, made the first time. Applies the next time it starts (the restart button).

settings.label: Command
settings.help: The command line that runs Claude. Applies the next time it starts (the restart button).

settings.label: Stop when idle
settings.help: Closed and not working this long, Claude stops; the next time the notch opens, a new one starts (/resume brings the session back). 0 keeps it running.

settings.label: Font
settings.help: A monospace font family for the terminal; empty uses the theme's. Applies the next time it starts (the restart button).
